materials.mapping: Global, world-anchored: in the terrain container's local (projected) coordinates, uv = (sx / 512, sy / 256) for every ground tile, where (sx, sy) is the drawn vertex position (z already applied). Tiles are one world period (8 x 8 units) of a world-periodic pattern, so they repeat on screen every 512 x 256 px at Pixi scale 1. No camera term, so no swimming; the same mapping on every chunk and LOD block, so no seams. Height shifts the pattern by z*32*sqrt(1.5) px, which is static and continuous.

sampler.note: power-of-two tiles; mipmaps prevent overview shimmer (Pixi otherwise minifies without them)

rules.when: flags == 255 (missing): draw nothing, exactly as today

materials.tint: Keep terrainMaterial()'s deterministic shade s = clamp(round(slope*9) + variation, -8, 9) but apply it as a multiplicative grey tint: rgb = 236 + 2*s per channel (range 220..254). Water: 0xF2FFFC when waterNeighbors < 4, else 0xFFFFFF.
materials.classification: Unchanged. The material is chosen from the persisted flags; nothing here alters flags, heights, the triangle split, walkability or LOD subdivision.

path.geometry: Authoritative centreline points and width w = widthQ/256 (founding path: width 1.5). Segments are axis-aligned. Subdivide each segment into pieces no longer than 1 unit and project every vertex with terrainReader.height (as the current stroke does).

core.shape: per segment: rectangle of width w - 0.30 along the segment; per vertex: square of side w - 0.30 centred on it (covers joins, T-junctions and crossings)

fringe.shape: per segment and side: quad from w/2 - 0.15 to w/2 + 0.42 off the centreline, outward
fringe.u: distance along the segment from its first point / 4 (repeat)
fringe.v: 0 at the inner edge, 1 at the outer edge

joint.shape: per vertex (corners, junctions and both ends): square of side 2.34 * (w / 1.5) centred on the vertex

path.drawOrder: joints, then fringes, then cores (cores opaque on top), all in the terrain layer below groundBand
path.result: The 50% alpha line of the soft edge sits on the authoritative edge (w/2); the core never leaves the saved width; nothing links unconnected paths or invents curves.
path.entranceEnds: WF2 paths end in a butt cap at the protected entrance. The end joint extends about 0.4 units under the apron and building step; it is a flat decal in the terrain layer and never changes occupancy.

strip.shape: for every grass cell (dry, not flag 8/2) edge shared with a woodland cell (dry, flag 8 or 2): quad on the grass side spanning that unit edge and extending 0.6 units into the grass cell, heights from terrainReader.height
strip.v: 0 at the shared edge, 1 at 0.6 units into the grass

woodland.purpose: softens the cell-staircase boundary between the two ground materials; drawn right after the ground fill, before banks and paths
woodland.missing: no strip against missing (255) or water cells

strip.shape: for every land cell edge returned by coastEdges(x, y, read.cell): quad on the water plane (z 0.5) spanning that unit edge and extending 0.5 units into the water cell
strip.v: 0 at the land edge, 1 at 0.5 units into the water

corner.shape: for each water cell corner whose diagonal neighbour is land and whose two orthogonal neighbours sharing that corner are water: a 0.5 x 0.5 square in that corner on the water plane
corner.uv: (0,0) at the land corner, axes pointing into the water cell

shore.concave: Where a water cell has land on two orthogonal sides the two strips overlap in the corner square; this is intended (a slightly brighter shallow).
shore.missing: A neighbour with flags 255 is neither land nor water: emit no strip, corner or bank against it.
shore.drawOrder: water fill, then bank faces, then shore strips and corners
shore.geometry: Purely cosmetic overlays on the existing water plane: no bank height, collision, walkability or navigable land changes.

placement.hash: h(x, y, salt) = (Math.imul(x, 73856093) ^ Math.imul(y, 19349663) ^ Math.imul(salt, 83492791)) >>> 0, with x, y the integer cell coordinates
placement.excluded: Never place on: missing cells (255); any structure, project/construction site or claim footprint including its entrance apron; any path rectangle expanded by 0.25 units; outside the active terrain window.
placement.lod: Decorations only when the chunk is drawn at step 1 (close zoom). Ground patches at every step. Water glints only at step 1.

rock.eligible: flags & 4 (authoritative ROCK cells, replacing the grey ellipse)

patches.anchor: sprite centre at the projected cell centre, sprite.scale = 0.5 (patches are authored at 2 px per runtime px, not on the Blender render scale)

water.eligible: flags & 1 and none of the 4 orthogonal neighbours is 255

shoreRule.when: at least one orthogonal neighbour is land
shoreRule.position: 0.3 units from the first land edge in N, E, S, W order, centred along it

water.anchor: terrainProject(x, y, 0.5): the frame anchor is the waterline

placement.sprites: artSprite(texture, renderScale) exactly as trees: scale ASSET_SCALE * renderScale; dry items also get their '-shadow' frame (renderScale 4) in naturalShadows at alpha 0.45. Depth key x + y like trees.

budgets.rule: stop placing when a cap is reached; caps never change world facts

waterGlint.eligible: open-water cells (all 8 neighbours water) with h(x,y,5) % 61 == 0
waterGlint.reducedMotion: do not create glints (frame 0 is the empty still)
waterGlint.emitter: none; fixed sprites updated from the existing ticker, no per-frame texture creation

budgets.note: 5 ground tiles (mipmapped) + 2 path edge + 1 woodland edge + 2 shore edge + 4 patches + 1 glint strip + 1 decor atlas page; decoded RGBA totals are recorded in the manifest
